description.html: The Habistat terrarium lock key is an essential safety accessory for every reptile owner. It prevents unauthorized opening of sliding glass doors, protecting your animals from escaping and giving you peace of mind when there are children or other pets in the household. Many reptile species are remarkably good at finding ways to open sliding doors, especially larger lizards and snakes, so a safety lock is practically a must.

It is easy to install - it fits on the top edge of the sliding doors with no drilling or gluing, and can be mounted in just a couple of minutes. The key locks and unlocks easily, and the compact design does not spoil the look of the terrarium. Habistat is a renowned British brand specializing in reptile equipment, known for the quality and reliability of its products.
